address: Đường Nguyễn Văn Công, Ward 3, Gò Vấp, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The original plane-spotting café: from the 2nd- and 3rd-floor balconies you look straight down the Tân Sơn Nhất runway as jets roar in to land every few minutes, sunset being the golden hour. Drinks and light bites 30–70k VND. Featured by VnExpress and Dân Trí as one of Saigon's two runway-view cafés.
dish: cà phê sữa with a runway view of landing planes

address: Đường Nguyễn Văn Công, Ward 3, Gò Vấp, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The milk-tea-leaning sibling right next door to Phen's, with its own open-air balcony over the same Tân Sơn Nhất runway — coffee, tea, yoghurt and smoothies 28–46k VND while planes drop overhead. Named alongside Phen's in the VnExpress / Dân Trí runway-café features.
dish: trà sữa / sinh tố on a runway-view rooftop

address: 672A50 Phan Văn Trị, Ward 10, Gò Vấp, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 24/7 multi-level check-in café whose façade and interior are covered in more than 700 teddy bears — from palm-sized plush to a 2.5 m giant — a ~500 million VND build by owner Trần Thế Hiển that went viral (and mildly controversial) across TikTok in 2025. A Gò Vấp 'sống ảo' phenomenon, not a specialty-coffee destination.
dish: photogenic teddy-bear café (Vietnamese coffee & sweet drinks)

address: Alley off Quang Trung (An Hội / An Nhơn ward), Gò Vấp, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Saigon's only Nigerian kitchen, tucked in a Gò Vấp courtyard behind a red 'Baby African Restaurant' sign and running informally out of the owner's home for nearly 20 years — jollof rice, African fried rice, egusi soup and stews. A repeat Saigoneer Hẻm Gems subject ('The Legend of Baby African' and 'Reliving the Joy of Jollof Rice').

n: Hủ Tiếu Mì Gốc Hoa Ông Há (Phan Huy Ích)
address: Đường Phan Huy Ích, Ward 12, Gò Vấp, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A family Hoa (ethnic-Chinese) egg-noodle shop on Phan Huy Ích that has held its recipe for ~38 years in Saigon's outer edge — springy hủ tiếu mì with hoành thánh (wontons). Documented by VnExpress both in a dedicated profile and in its citywide hủ tiếu round-up.
dish: hủ tiếu mì hoành thánh (Hoa-style egg noodles & wontons)
